headline: Working from home: lightweight and oil-free
subhead: Use after cleansing, toning and your serums. AM & PM, every day.
footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 899 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person photo (person_prompt) fills the rounded card in the right-hand zone and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; the real pack shot stands large in front of the photo on a soft plinth (lower left of the card); rating line in the footnote band, CTA "Shop now" bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a bright off-white wall beside a window with the edge of a sheer white curtain at the far left, soft daylight from the upper left and a faint warm-grey gradient towards the lower right. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: lifestyle (working from home by a window). The moment is carried by the page's own texture and usage facts: a lightweight, oil-free moisturizer (F3), used after cleansing, toning and serums, AM & PM (F13, F14); proof lines are F3, F7 and F11. Kept: fact lines under the headline (Dot & Key), editorial scene with minimal copy (Foxtale), feature lines beside the pack (Deconstruct). Dropped: 'Brightens'/'Reduces' tag cards, NEW bubble, 'India's 1st' claim, every repair, barrier, wound-healing and radical-scavenging line (F2, F3 'repairing', F5, F6, F15, F20-F22), and the 12-hour, hydration and irritation stats (F16-F18). The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled). Rating in the footnote slot.

blend_sources.took: short ingredient-and-fact lines under the headline in place of benefit tag cards
editorial, scene-led mood: one person in a real setting beside a minimal message
feature callouts sitting beside the pack, limited to page facts

person_prompt: An Indian woman in her early 40s with medium-brown skin, working from home by a window: she sits at a small wooden desk in a bright corner of her living room with a laptop open (its screen turned away from the camera), a plain ceramic cup, a potted money plant on the windowsill and sheer white curtains moving slightly beside her. She wears a soft cotton kurta in a muted colour with her dark hair, a few natural grey strands at the temples, clipped up, pausing to look out of the window with a calm, thoughtful expression. Soft daylight from the window at the upper left, medium shot at eye level, shallow depth of field, framed so she sits slightly left of centre with calm space to her right. Natural, unretouched medium-brown skin with visible pores and ordinary variation in tone, true to life, nothing implying a skin result. No product, bottle, dropper, tube, jar or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
